milestones.name: first-slice
milestones.description: The first slice in Lean: accepting an offer, delivering a service, payments and refunds, with three proven guarantees and the open refund question.

milestones.name: candidates-identified
milestones.description: The first ONE Order survey adds 23 candidate rules to the blueprint; 12 wait on a business decision.

milestones.name: starting-small
milestones.description: Starting small: the slice in Lean, 23 candidates, the review site and the coverage map. The version to propose for an internal pilot.

milestones.name: oneorder-foundations
milestones.description: The ONE Order foundations are in Lean: services, order items, orders, acceptance and the status rules, with two open questions about statuses.

milestones.name: second-survey
milestones.description: The second survey round read every area in full and added 138 candidate rules, most of them decisions for the business.

milestones.name: change-cancellation
milestones.description: Seller-initiated change and cancellation is in Lean: price differentials, penalties, cancelling, changing an item and the money recorded, with five open questions.

milestones.name: payment
milestones.description: Payment is in Lean: payment status, paid items, accepting a payment with surcharges, payment outcomes and unpaid items at their time limit, with three open questions.

milestones.name: delivery
milestones.description: Delivery is in Lean: moves between delivery statuses, services that end without delivery, final statuses and suspension, with two open questions.

milestones.name: order-creation
milestones.description: Order creation is in Lean: selecting items, creating one order from several offers, repeated requests, versions and history, stale changes and retention, with nine open questions.

milestones.name: airline-change
milestones.description: Airline-initiated change is in Lean: answering a change notice, missed time limits, declining a change, cancelling a flight and re-accommodation, with eight open questions.

milestones.name: offers-prices
milestones.description: Offers, prices and conditions are in Lean: price guarantees, time limits of a new order, restriction rules, voluntary changes, cancellation refunds and price totals, with seven open questions.

milestones.name: ancillaries
milestones.description: Ancillaries, seats and bundles are in Lean: dependent services, adding and cancelling ancillaries, replacing a flight, seats, a-la-carte items and bundles, with eleven open questions.

milestones.name: accounting
milestones.description: Commission, accounting and settlement are in Lean: commission, clearances, clearings, net positions, short remittances, billing and the books, with ten open questions.
